ranks: Onslaught (ONS, 2002-10-07): its 105 most-played cards left, by EDHREC rank (Cryptic Gateway to Goblin Taskmaster) — the fourth middle walk's third batch, round nineteen; the rest of the set (94) is round twenty's. Built morph costs that aren't mana (MorphCost.also: pay life, sacrifice, discard, return to hand — rule 702.37e) and authored the six cards it unblocked in other sets (Zombie Cutthroat, Putrid Raptor, Raven Guild Initiate and Skirk Volcanist from Scourge; Fathom Seer and Gathan Raiders)

blocked.name: Cryptic Gateway
blocked.why: "Tap two untapped creatures you control: You may put a creature card from your hand onto the battlefield that shares a creature type with each creature tapped this way": the put filter can't read the creatures the tapOthers cost tapped.

blocked.name: Jareth, Leonine Titan
blocked.why: "{W}: Jareth gains protection from the color of your choice until end of turn": no effect grants protection; it's a static only.

blocked.name: Peer Pressure
blocked.why: "If you control more creatures of the chosen type than each other player": strictly more than each other player; opponent-controls-more negated says "at least as many".

blocked.name: Words of Wind
blocked.why: "{1}: The next time you would draw a card this turn, instead each player returns a permanent they control": no one-shot next-draw replacement set up by an ability.

blocked.name: Backslide
blocked.why: "Turn target creature with a morph ability face down": not built.

blocked.name: Harsh Mercy
blocked.why: Each player chooses a creature type; choose-creature-type asks only the controller.

blocked.name: Soulless One
blocked.why: P/T equal to Zombies on the battlefield plus Zombie cards in graveyards: a CDA reads one count.

blocked.name: Imagecrafter
blocked.why: "Choose a creature type other than Wall. Target creature becomes that type": the choice can't exclude Wall, and types can only be added.

blocked.name: Mistform Mutant
blocked.why: As Imagecrafter.

blocked.name: Kamahl's Summons
blocked.why: Each player reveals any number of creature cards from their hand, then makes a 2/2 Bear per card revealed: no such reveal.

blocked.name: False Cure
blocked.why: "Until end of turn, whenever a player gains life, that player loses 2 life for each 1 life gained": no turn-long trigger from a spell.

blocked.name: Kaboom!
blocked.why: Reveal-until puts the rest on the bottom at random, not in any order; the ruling's target order is unmodeled too.

blocked.name: Riptide Replicator
blocked.why: A token of the color and creature type chosen as it entered.

blocked.name: Crown of Awe
blocked.why: "Sacrifice Crown of Awe: Enchanted creature and other creatures that share a creature type with it gain protection from black and from red until end of turn".

blocked.name: Biorhythm
blocked.why: "Each player's life total becomes the number of creatures they control": no per-player count.

blocked.name: Trickery Charm
blocked.why: Mode 2, "target creature becomes the creature type of your choice", replaces its types.

blocked.name: Read the Runes
blocked.why: "For each card drawn this way, discard a card unless you sacrifice a permanent": a simultaneous sacrifice of any number.

blocked.name: Artificial Evolution
blocked.why: Text change of creature-type words (AUTHORING §15).

blocked.name: Tempting Wurm
blocked.why: Each opponent's cards are put onto the battlefield at once; a for-each-player look-and-choose moves them one player at a time.

blocked.name: Aurification
blocked.why: "When Aurification leaves the battlefield, remove all gold counters from all creatures".

blocked.name: Words of Worship
blocked.why: As Words of Wind.

blocked.name: Sea's Claim

blocked.name: Supreme Inquisitor
blocked.why: Search target player's library for up to five cards and exile them.

blocked.name: Quicksilver Dragon
blocked.why: "If target spell has only one target and that target is this creature, change that spell's target to another creature".

blocked.name: Ixidor, Reality Sculptor

blocked.name: Words of Waste
blocked.why: As Words of Wind.

blocked.name: Words of War
blocked.why: As Words of Wind.

blocked.name: Akroma's Blessing
blocked.why: "Choose a color. Creatures you control gain protection from the chosen color until end of turn".

blocked.name: Head Games
blocked.why: Target opponent puts their hand on top; you search their library for that many cards.
